◈ FOUNDER & OWNER
WHO IS MR ZF

Zulkaif Akbar

Founder · CEO · Chief Fabric Selector

Salaam! I'm Zulkaif — the man behind Mr ZF. What started as one student's obsession with honest, heavyweight Khaddar has become a small studio with one rule: if I wouldn't wear it myself, I don't sell it. Every fabric you see here was checked by hand — weight, weave, colour-fastness, shrinkage — before it earned a place on this page.

I'm building Mr ZF the way a good system is built: transparent prices, a live auto-sale on every item, honest stock counts, and a reply to every message — usually within a day, straight from me or my team.

"Khaddar isn't just cloth. It's our winter, our heritage, our identity — stitched with patience, worn with pride."
— Zulkaif Akbar · signed from Kamalia, Punjab

✦ THE STUDIO

BUILT ON FABRIC,
RUN LIKE A SYSTEM

Mr ZF is a Kamalia-based menswear studio specialising in Khaddar — the hand-woven winter cloth Punjab has worn for generations. We keep the old weave, and run everything else like a modern system: live prices, transparent stock, auto-sale instead of fake "sales", and delivery tracking over WhatsApp.

Seasonal comfort, engineeredFour weights from 250 GSM transitional to 400+ GSM extreme-winter Khaddar.
Selected varieties onlyWe stock few colours and master them, instead of stocking everything badly.
Satisfied customers, honest repliesQuestions answered personally — before and after the order.

QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

§ POLICIES

SHIPPING · RETURNS · PRIVACY

▸ SHIPPING POLICY [EDITABLE TEMPLATE]

  • Delivery across Pakistan, 2–4 working days to major cities.
  • Flat shipping Rs 199 — free over Rs 5,000.
  • Courier: TCS / Leopards / PakisTaani — confirmed on call.
  • Orders placed after 6 PM are processed next working day.

▸ RETURN & EXCHANGE [EDITABLE TEMPLATE]

  • 7-day exchange on unused fabric in original condition.
  • Stitched or cut fabric is not returnable.
  • Video the parcel opening for claims — it speeds things up.
  • Return courier is paid by the customer unless the fault is ours.

▸ PRIVACY NOTICE [EDITABLE TEMPLATE]

Your name, phone and address are used only to deliver your order and are shared with nobody except the courier. Cart data stays in your own browser. We never store card details — payments happen over COD or direct bank transfer.

▸ TERMS OF SALE

Every order submitted is a request — it becomes final once we confirm availability and total on call or WhatsApp. Prices shown include the live auto-sale and can change with stock seasons.
